about_the_game:
Beast Siege is an online co-op game where ordinary warriors take on colossal Beasts. In a medieval fantasy world without magic, they rely on gunpowder technology for explosive recoil jumps, gunpowder-powered hammer strikes, and more.

Experience the next generation of gaming with fully physics-driven interactive combat and seamless network synchronization.

Every movement of the gigantic Beasts reacts to player actions through real-time physics interactions, allowing them to overcome obstacles naturally and create lifelike motion never seen before in any game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX-2000 series / AMD RX-6000 series
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT / INTEL Arc A750

short_description: An online co-op action RPG for up to 8 players. Raid fully physics-based gigantic beasts, climb onto them to smash their heads, and experience full-physics intense next-gen action battles with your party.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
